name: prisoner squat
description: A bodyweight squat with your hands behind your head. It keeps your chest open and builds leg strength.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and place your hands behind your head.
Pull your elbows back and keep your chest up.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower down.
Go until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.
